changeSet.author: aegis
changeSet.comment: Seed the Aegis License admin menu row
changeSet.sql: INSERT INTO clinlims.menu (id, presentation_order, element_id, action_url, display_key, tool_tip_key, new_window, is_active, hide_in_old_ui) SELECT nextval('clinlims.menu_seq'), (SELECT COALESCE(MAX(presentation_order), 0) + 1 FROM clinlims.menu WHERE parent_id IS NULL), 'menu_aegis_license', '/license', 'sideNav.label.license', 'sideNav.label.license', false, true, true WHERE NOT EXISTS (SELECT 1 FROM clinlims.menu WHERE element_id = 'menu_aegis_license');
